bmc.6: 0.32 RTX 6000 Ada 48GB GPU nodes with 25% peak buffer (48,000,000 T/mo) + NIN domestic CPU/DB/BGP (30,000,000 T/mo). Stack: LightGBM / Prophet Jalali Seasonality + OR-Tools Constraint Solver + Qwen3-8B Explainer on CPU/Shared GPU. Dataset: LLM + RAG and proprietary Persian developer, data & it ops data.
bmc.7: Maintaining accuracy on LLM + RAG; keeping developer, data & it ops integrations and NIN/BGP routing live; enforcing monthly Toman billing and quarterly CPI/FX indexation to protect riyal margins from inflation.
bmc.8: Distribution & API partners: category resellers, agencies and local marketplaces. Infrastructure: Sindad/Afranet (GPU/NIN), Zarinpal/Payping (Shaparak gateway) and the Innovation and Prosperity Fund / knowledge-based tax exemptions.
